report_name: Medical Billing Firm MCBS Breach Affects 1.2M; PEAR Ransomware Blamed

threat_actors.name: PEAR
threat_actors.description: PEAR is an extortion-focused ransomware group that claimed responsibility for the MCBS data breach. The group specializes in data theft for extortion, prioritizing it over encryption. They exfiltrated 3 TB of data from MCBS and later leaked it when a ransom was not paid. The group is known for targeting the healthcare sector.
threat_actors.goals: Data theft for the purpose of extortion and financial gain.

attack_patterns.name: Archive Collected Data
attack_patterns.description: The exfiltration of 3 TB of data suggests the attackers collected and staged the sensitive patient data in large archives before transfer, a behavior consistent with T1560.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The PEAR group exfiltrated 3 terabytes of sensitive patient data from the MCBS network over several days, a primary method for large-scale data theft.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
attack_patterns.description: The exfiltration of 3 TB of data may have been conducted using cloud storage services, a method consistent with T1567 and suggested by hunting hints for tools like rclone.

malware.name: PEAR Ransomware
malware.description: A ransomware associated with the PEAR group, used in a data breach against MCBS. Its primary function is data theft and extortion, rather than file encryption.

tools.name: rclone
tools.description: Mentioned as a tool to hunt for, used for command-line cloud storage synchronization which can be abused for data exfiltration.

tools.name: MegaCMD
tools.description: Mentioned as a tool to hunt for, used for command-line cloud storage synchronization which can be abused for data exfiltration.

identities.name: Medical Computer Business Services
identities.description: An Atlanta-based medical revenue cycle management firm that suffered a data breach affecting 1,261,464 individuals. The company acts as a business associate for multiple healthcare organizations.

identities.name: Motility Software Solutions
identities.description: A previous victim of the PEAR ransomware group, with 766,000 individuals affected.

identities.name: Tri-Century Eye Care
identities.description: A previous victim of the PEAR ransomware group, with 200,000 individuals affected.

infrastructure.name: PEAR Leak Site
infrastructure.description: The dark web site used by the PEAR ransomware group to list MCBS as a victim and eventually publish the 3 TB of stolen data.

indicators.name: Data Staging via Common Archive Utilities
indicators.pattern:
title: Data Staging with Common Archive Utilities
id: d3f4a5b6-c7d8-4e9f-a0b1-c2d3e4f5a6b7
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of large archive files (zip, rar, 7z) on servers, which may indicate data staging prior to exfiltration.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-27
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/mcbs-data-breach-affects-1-2-million-individuals/
tags:
  - attack.t1560.001
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.zip'
      - '.rar'
      - '.7z'
  filter:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\winzip.exe'
      - '\7z.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter
indicators.description: Detects the creation of large archive files on servers, which may indicate data staging prior to exfiltration, as suggested by hunting hints in the report.

indicators.name: Data Exfiltration using Cloud Sync Tools
indicators.pattern:
title: Data Exfiltration using Cloud Sync Tools
id: e8f9a0b1-c2d3-4e4f-5a6b-7c8d9e0f1a2b
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of command-line cloud synchronization tools such as rclone.exe or megacmd.exe, which can be used for data exfiltration.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-27
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/mcbs-data-breach-affects-1-2-million-individuals/
tags:
  - attack.t1567
  - attack.exfiltration
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rclone.exe'
      - '\megacmd.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of command-line cloud storage synchronization tools, like rclone and MegaCMD, which are noted as potential data exfiltration vectors used by groups like PEAR.
